sim.label: Simulation
sim.lost: The simulation was interrupted. Please start it again.
sim.timeout: The simulation is taking unusually long. Please try again later.
sim.doneItems: Simulation done: {count} raider(s), {items} item(s). The DPS are in the tables now.
sim.diffTipSub: WoWSims, same seed for every candidate.

skipped.one: {count} raider does not belong to this raid category.
skipped.other: {count} raiders do not belong to this raid category.

category.noAssignment: Without a maintained assignment (Settings → Categories), anyone who was neither logged nor won anything here is missing.
category.nothingFound: Nobody can be matched to this category: no evaluated logs, no loot with this category and no raider assignment. Quickest fix: Settings → Categories (raider ↔ character), or evaluate a log of this raid and assign it to the event.

page.roleCleared: Role for {character} reset — the data decides again.
page.armoryUnknownOne: The armory does not know {character} (or is not answering right now) — the last evaluation stays.
page.armoryUnknownAll: The armory answered for nobody — the last evaluation stays.

armoryLoaded.one: Armory loaded: {taken} of {count} raider with current gear.
armoryLoaded.other: Armory loaded: {taken} of {count} raiders with current gear.

page.armoryLoadedOne: Armory loaded: {character} now has current gear.
page.armoryPvp: {names}: the armory shows PvP gear — the set from the last raid stays.
page.armoryRole: {names}: the armory shows a set for the other role — the set from the last raid stays.
page.logPvp: {character} wears PvP gear in {from} — the set from the evaluation stays.
page.logRole: {character} wears a set for the other role in {from} — the set from the evaluation stays.
page.evaluationBack: {character} is judged by the last evaluation again.
page.excludeText: Stays in the history and can be planned again at any time — only leaves this list, and the need values of the others shift.

roster.title: Whose turn is it?
roster.tipSub: Whoever has gone longest without anything is at the top. A raider's details show gear, BiS gaps and loot.
roster.empty: No matching raiders. The loot council reads class and spec from the loot imports and the CLA evaluations — without them the list stays empty.

list.needTipSub: Waiting time, loot share and BiS gap, weighted 50 / 40 / 10. Whoever has gone longest without anything is at the top.
list.lootTipSub: In the current content filter — the latest are in the tooltip.
list.bisTipSub: Worn pieces of the BiS list.
list.dpsTipSub: Simulated with WoWSims — empty until calculated.
list.noGearTipSub: The raider does not appear in any of the latest evaluations — in the details you can load a log or fetch the armory.
list.pvpTipSub: Every recent evaluation shows this raider in PvP gear. Read the numbers with care.
list.roleTipSub: No set of the planned role logged — {title} is judged, where the other role was played.
list.sitTipSub: {count} slot(s) hold a boss-specific piece — the comparison reads the slot as empty.
list.borrowedTipSub: {spec} has no list of its own — measured against {from}.
list.dpsNoSimTipSub: WoWSims-TBC does not simulate this spec.
list.dpsNoGearTipSub: Without gear there is nothing to simulate.
list.bisBorrowed: List of {from} (this spec has none of its own).

gaps.title: What is still missing?
gaps.tipSub: Items on at least one BiS list that nobody in the filtered group wears yet — sorted by how many are waiting for them. The suggestion is the biggest gain, not the longest wait: you decide whose turn it is.
gaps.runAllTipSub: Runs every open BiS item against every raider — thorough, but takes minutes. For a single item “Check drop” is faster.
gaps.empty: No open BiS items in the chosen filter — either the group already wears everything, or there is no BiS list for their specs in this tier.
gaps.needTipSub: There is no simulation for these specs (WoWSims-TBC does not simulate healing). The suggestion follows the need — no gain is estimated.
gaps.pendingTipSub: “Check as drop” calculates it in seconds, “Simulate all BiS items” the whole list.
gaps.noneTipSub: No fitting slot for any of the filtered raiders.

drop.loadFailed: The drop could not be loaded.
drop.title: Who gets the drop?
drop.searchFirst: Type an item name, e.g. Zhar'doom …
drop.noItem: No item chosen yet — search top right. The search runs over the bot's item table; anyone who cannot equip the piece is not among the candidates.
drop.unknownItem: The bot's item table does not know this item.
drop.noListTipSub: Not on any BiS list of the chosen tier — can still be an upgrade.
drop.needTipSub: WoWSims-TBC does not simulate healing. The suggestion follows the need — the page cannot say what the piece brings, because it cannot measure it.
drop.pendingRunning: Simulation running — the progress is shown at the bottom centre. The recommendation appears once it is done.
drop.pendingIdle: Not simulated yet. Without a simulation there is no recommendation — nothing is estimated.
drop.noSlot: No fitting slot for any raider in the current filter — check the role or filter on the raider page.
drop.noSimAvailable: No simulation available. Without it there is no gain and no recommendation — nothing is estimated.
drop.candidatesTipSub: What the item brings (simulated only), and what the raider is due — the council weighs the two.

candidates.noSimTipSub: There is no simulation for this spec — WoWSims-TBC only simulates caster DPS.
candidates.noGearTipSub: The raider does not appear in any of the latest evaluations.
candidates.pendingTipSub: Included automatically in “Simulate again” — or on its own with the button on the right.
candidates.notComparableTipSub: {list}. The gain comes out higher than for raiders with a normal piece in the slot.
candidates.noBisTipSub: Not on this raider's BiS list — gain and need count at {pct} %.
candidates.listTipSub: Is the item on the raider's list? If not, gain and need count half.
candidates.replacesTipSub: What would come off — every slot it fits; sorted by item level, a free slot first.
candidates.gainTipSub: Simulated DPS difference from WoWSims, same seed for everyone. If the item is not BiS, the gain counts half (hatched). Nothing is estimated: without a simulation the cell stays empty.
candidates.needTipSub: Waiting time, loot share and BiS gap, weighted 50 / 40 / 10 — halved if the item is not BiS for the raider.

compare.wornTip: On the BiS list and worn — just not awarded in this loot
compare.openTip: On the BiS list and still missing
compare.raidersHint: {active} of {total} raiders from the filter above. The content filter decides which loot counts — off-spec, disenchant and bank are not shown here.
compare.noRaiders: No matching raiders in the filter.
compare.matrixHint: {items} items in {raids} raid(s) · rows like a character sheet, columns are the raiders — whoever has gone longest without anything is on the left.
compare.legend: on their list and still missing
compare.noneSelected: No raider selected — switch one back on above.
compare.nothingReceived: None of the chosen raiders received anything in the current content filter.

source.wowsims: Simulated WoWSims set — with sockets and enchants.
source.wowhead: Written Wowhead recommendation — names items, no sockets and no enchants.

bisLists.loadFailed: The BiS lists could not be loaded.
bisLists.searchHint: The other way round: enter a piece, see which specs it is BiS for — and jump from there into the list, filtered to exactly those.
bisLists.searchPlaceholder: Item name, e.g. Skull of Gul'dan
bisLists.filterTip: Filter the list to {spec} and highlight the piece there
bisLists.notOnList: Not on any list of this tier.
bisLists.specsHint: {specs} specs, {lists} lists. A spec without its own list plays another spec's — the column says so.
bisLists.tierMissing: There is no set of this tier for {specs}
bisLists.matrixHint: {shown} of {total} lists · {contested} pieces are on more than one
bisLists.userBorrowTip: Plays this list, has none of its own
bisLists.noSpec: No spec selected — switch one back on above.

items.alsoFor: The same list also applies to {specs} — WoWSims has none of their own.
items.otherTipSub: {count} item(s) for off-spec, disenchant or the bank — do not count as loot received.
items.more: … and {count} more — the full list is in the details.
items.otherNote: Plus {count} × off-spec, disenchant or bank — does not count as loot received.

need.weighted: Weighted 50 / 40 / 10: whoever waits long counts most.

filter.contentTipSub: Which raids count for loot. Without a choice all loot counts; tiers and single raids can be combined (“T5 plus Hyjal”) while the guild is switching.
filter.derivedTipSub: Measured against the list of the tier the guild's newest loot comes from.

gearArmory.one: {armory} of {count} raider with gear from the armory, the rest from the last evaluation.
gearArmory.other: {armory} of {count} raiders with gear from the armory, the rest from the last evaluation.

filter.gearAllLog: All gear comes from the last evaluation — anyone who put on something since is judged with the old set.
filter.gearEnchants: Enchants still come from the evaluations: Blizzard's enchant ids are not the ones WoWSims expects. A piece that is new since then is calculated unenchanted and comes out a little low.
filter.simTipSub: {done} of {total} simulatable raiders have a DPS. A gain only appears with a simulation — the page shows no estimates from stat weights.

gear.wornBisTipSub: {item} is on this raider's BiS list.
gear.wornNoEnchTipSub: {item} has no enchant. The simulation calculates the piece as it is.
gear.emptySocketsTipSub: The simulation calculates the socket as empty.
gear.sitMarkTip: Does not count in the comparison
gear.replacedSameRaid: The {note}. Shown is what sat in the slot in the same raid.
gear.replacedSameRaidFight: The {note}. Shown is what sat in the slot in the same raid at {fight}.
gear.replacedOlder: The {note}. Shown is what {source} shows in the slot.
gear.twoHandTipSub: Takes main hand and off hand, both pieces come off.
gear.armoryUnverified: {count} piece(s) are new since the last evaluation — no enchant is known for them, the simulation calculates them unenchanted.
gear.wclTipSub: Loaded {date}. Applies until a newer evaluation comes in or “Evaluation” is chosen.
gear.logSkipped: {count} newer evaluation(s) skipped, because healing or PvP gear was seen there.
gear.logDefault: The set of the last evaluation in which this raider played their role.
gear.hitTipSub: Worn / cap against bosses. Above the cap, hit no longer counts in the comparison.
gear.bisTipSub: Worn pieces of this raider's BiS list.
gear.noEnchTipSub: Pieces without an enchant — marked with ! on the icon.
gear.socketsTipSub: Marked top right on the icon.
gear.unverifiedTipSub: New since the last evaluation: Blizzard's enchant ids are not the ones WoWSims expects, the simulation calculates them unenchanted.
gear.pvpTipSub: Every recent evaluation shows this raider in PvP gear. No other set is known, read the numbers with care.
gear.otherRoleTipSub: From “{title}” — the other role was played there. No set of the planned role is logged.
gear.logRejectedTipSub: The loaded log was not taken — the set from the evaluation is still judged.
gear.armoryRejectedTipSub: The armory's answer was not taken — it does not count against a boss, the set from the last raid is still judged.
gear.sitTipSub: {count} slot(s) hold a boss-specific piece, and no older evaluation shows anything else there. The comparison reads the slot as empty.
gear.subTipSub: {count} slot(s) hold a piece today that only counts against certain bosses — compared with what usually sits there (icon with ↺).
gear.droppedTipSub: “{item}” {note}. The slot counts as empty, because no other source says what {character} usually wears there.
gear.pvpHintHead: PvP gear — no boss set known.
gear.pvpHint: Every recent evaluation shows {character} in an arena set; resilience is worth nothing against a boss. Load gear from the armory or a log to simulate.
gear.noGear: No gear known — not seen in any evaluation.
gear.armoryFetchNow: Get gear from the armory now

log.newestSub: tries the latest logs in turn
log.none: The bot does not know any log yet — paste a Warcraft Logs link.

export.name: Sim export
export.title: WoWSims export — {character}
export.step3: Paste the JSON below and confirm

dialog.roleFixed: Set like this — click again to undo
dialog.needTipSub: Waiting time, loot share and BiS gap, weighted 50 / 40 / 10.
dialog.itemsTipSub: In the content filter · in total. Off-spec, disenchant and bank do not count.
dialog.dpsTipSub: Simulated with WoWSims, same seed for everyone.
dialog.sourceLogTip: The set from the last evaluation
dialog.sourceLogBackTip: Back to the set from the last evaluation
dialog.sourceWclTip: Load gear from a log: one of the bot's latest logs or a Warcraft Logs link
dialog.sourceArmoryAgainTip: Fetch gear from the armory again
dialog.sourceArmoryTip: Fetch gear from the armory — the current state
dialog.noGear: No gear known — not seen in any evaluation. Load a log above or fetch the armory.
dialog.wowheadNote: Written Wowhead list: names items, no sockets and no enchants.
dialog.noBisList: There is no BiS list for this spec and tier.
dialog.lootTipSub: Off-spec, disenchant and bank do not count as loot received.
dialog.noLoot: Received nothing in the chosen content.
